open: Gameweek six. Two derbies, a league leader under investigation, and PJ, who still hasn't won a fucking game. Here's how it lines up.

Trophy Hunters. Bryant has won three on the bounce. First time anyone's called that team name accurate.

The Soaring Gulls. Two hundred and forty points, the most in the league. CJ, the league's premier stat-padder.

Ethan leads the series four to three. The model still backs CJ. It's seen Ethan's transfers.
In It to McGinn It. Nate lost by a point, then by twenty-six. Hard done by to dogshit in seven days.
Fernandes leads the eleven against Spurs. Porro and Rashford are seventy-five percent, which in Nate's world rounds down to zero.
Team Jacob. Lost by four, lost by one. Jacob isn't losing, he's just finishing second every single week.
Saka leads the eleven, at home to Leeds. Mbeumo hosts Spurs as well, so Old Trafford decides this one. Condolences to both.
First ever meeting, and the model makes Jacob a clear favourite. Nate, thoughts and prayers.

close: That's the gameweek. Lineups in before Saturday's deadline, and get yourself on the record. Cowards stay quiet.
